claims.claim: Sharp AR-M201 All-in-One Digital Copier for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Sharp multifunction/copier with lid open and control panel visible, but the exact model number (AR-M201) is not clearly readable in the provided report.

claims.claim: Fairly used, fully functional, and ready to...
claims.evidence: Photos show the unit physically, but no print/copy/fax test results or operational proof are shown.
No counter/page count display is shown or readable in the witness report.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted.
claims.evidence: No cartridge/drum labels, installation date, or close-up of consumables are shown.
No jam/error history or test run is shown; photos only show internal paper path/rollers with lid open.

risks.risk: Model number may be wrong or incomplete (pricing depends heavily on exact Sharp AR-series model and capabilities).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial label (usually rear/side) and the control panel model text, plus a screenshot/photo of the machine information/menu showing model and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Sharp multifunction copier with unknown exact model/capabilities (worst-case compatibility and feature set).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (could have intermittent faults, scanning/copy issues, or feed problems).
risks.proof: A short video of a full copy test: load paper, run a copy, show output page, and show no error/jam on the display.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/untested for printing/copying (worst-case for buyer risk).

risks.risk: Consumables condition uncertain (even if “new drum/toner” is claimed, actual drum life and toner quality may be poor).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum/toner compartments with labels/part numbers and a photo of the machine’s consumables status (toner/drum life %).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown consumables condition (worst-case: may need replacement soon).

risks.risk: Paper feed/rollers and internal mechanism may be worn or misaligned (photos show parts but not wear or performance).
risks.proof: Video showing multiple pages feeding and stacking correctly (e.g., 10–20 pages) with no skewing or jams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential feed/roller wear risk (worst-case: may require service/roller replacement).

risks.risk: Connectivity and power readiness unknown (USB/Wi‑Fi/Ethernet may not work; power supply issues possible).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the machine connected (if applicable) and a successful scan/print/copy from a device, plus a clear view of the ports and network settings page (if Wi‑Fi/Ethernet).
risks.if_unproven: Price as standalone copier only with unknown connectivity (worst-case: buyer may not be able to use it for scanning/printing).

risks.risk: Counter/page count claim not verifiable (high usage can mean more wear even if it “works”).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the counter/page count screen from the machine menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-usage worst case since page count is not confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact model number and serial number label (rear/side) and a photo of the control panel info/menu showing model.
Photo of the machine’s page/counter screen (showing total copies).
Close-up photos of drum and toner compartments plus any consumables status screen (toner/drum life %).
Short video of a complete copy test (single page and then a small batch) showing no jam/error.
If claiming “all-in-one” includes scanning/fax/printing: show a successful scan/print from a phone/PC (or at least the relevant function) and a clear view of the ports/network settings.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Sharp multifunction/copier, but the exact model and key value drivers (counter, consumables condition, and functional test) are not verifiable from the provided report. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
